description: This file defines classes and functions for implementing a push-to-talk feature with voice recognition on macOS. It includes handling for hotkeys, speech recognition sessions, and audio input management.

classes.name: VoicePushToTalkHotkey
classes.description: Manages global and local hotkey monitoring for right Option key to trigger push-to-talk voice recognition sessions.

classes.name: VoicePushToTalk
classes.description: Handles the lifecycle of voice recognition sessions, audio input, and speech recognition tasks during push-to-talk interactions.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables event monitoring based on the flag.

methods.name: startMonitoring
methods.description: Starts listening for system and app-specific key events.

methods.name: updateModifierState
methods.description: Updates internal state based on key code and modifier flags; triggers voice recognition start if hotkey pressed.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Starts a new speech recognition session if supported and not already active.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends the current speech recognition session gracefully.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Configures and begins the speech recognition engine and audio input.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes recognition transcripts and updates UI overlays.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Completes the recognition session, posts results, and cleans up resources.
